posts.content: spirula-studio: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer - video to splat to mesh, Vulkan or CUDA.

ai.title: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer - video to splat to mesh, Vulkan or CUDA
ai.summary: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting training tool that processes video input to splat representations and converts to mesh. Supports both Vulkan and CUDA backends for hardware flexibility.
ai.why_important: Provides hardware-agnostic 3DGS training pipeline from video capture to usable mesh assets, removing vendor lock-in.
ai.learnings: 3DGS training can run on both Vulkan and CUDA, enabling complete video-to-splat-to-mesh pipeline regardless of GPU vendor.

posts.content: blender-ai-mcp-addon: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows. Works with OpenAI, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenCode. Blender AI addon and plugin, copilot for 3D, bpy Python scripting, MCP integration.

ai.title: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows
ai.summary: Blender addon integrating MCP server protocol for AI-driven 3D workflows with visual chat, scene manipulation tools, and multi-agent automation. Supports multiple LLM providers and bpy Python scripting assistance.
ai.why_important: Bridges AI assistants directly into Blender's 3D environment with standardized MCP protocol, enabling conversational scene editing and scripting help.
ai.learnings: MCP server protocol can be embedded in Blender addons to enable multi-LLM scene manipulation and Python scripting assistance within the 3D viewport.

posts.content: dsh-blender-plugin: DSH × Blender 直连实时插件：15 个模型工具让 AI 驱动 GUI Blender；v2.4 起编辑模式点/线/面、姿态骨骼也能随选中送进 DSH 草稿（含多选/集合模式与 human/agent 判定），随包建模 skill，支持 WSL / Windows / macOS。

ai.title: DSH × Blender 直连实时插件：15 个模型工具让 AI 驱动 GUI Blender；v2.4 起编辑模式点/线/面、姿态骨骼也能随选中送进 DSH 草稿
ai.summary: DSH 与 Blender 的实时直连插件，提供 15 个 AI 模型工具驱动 Blender GUI。v2.4 版本支持编辑模式下的点/线/面选择、姿态骨骼实时发送到 DSH 草稿，包含多选和集合模式及人机判定功能。
ai.why_important: 实现 AI 工具与 Blender 编辑模式的实时双向通信，可将选中的几何元素和骨骼直接送入 AI 工作流。
ai.learnings: Blender 编辑模式的点/线/面选择和骨骼姿态可实时发送到 DSH AI 系统，支持跨平台（WSL/Windows/macOS）多选和集合操作。

posts.content: 3DGenStudio: Orchestrate complete 3D generation pipelines — from text-to-image, image editing, mesh generation, UV unwrapping, to texturing — all in a single visual workspace powered by ComfyUI and external APIs.

ai.title: Orchestrate complete 3D generation pipelines in ComfyUI - text-to-image to texturing
ai.summary: Visual workspace orchestrating end-to-end 3D asset generation in ComfyUI, chaining text-to-image, image editing, mesh generation, UV unwrapping, and texturing. Integrates external APIs into unified ComfyUI workflows.
ai.why_important: Unifies fragmented 3D generation steps into single visual pipeline, eliminating manual hand-offs between tools for text-to-textured-mesh workflow.
ai.learnings: Complete 3D asset pipeline from text prompt to textured mesh can be orchestrated in ComfyUI by chaining image generation, mesh extraction, UV unwrapping, and texturing nodes with external API calls.

posts.content: comfyui-krea2edit: Instruction-based, identity-preserving image editing for Krea 2 in ComfyUI — nodes + workflows for the Krea 2 Identity Edit LoRA

ai.title: Instruction-based, identity-preserving image editing for Krea 2 in ComfyUI
ai.summary: Custom ComfyUI nodes implementing Krea 2's Identity Edit LoRA for instruction-based image editing while preserving subject identity. Includes workflow examples for identity-consistent editing operations.
ai.why_important: Enables identity-preserving iterative editing directly in ComfyUI workflows, critical for character consistency across image variations.
ai.learnings: Krea 2's Identity Edit LoRA can be integrated into ComfyUI through custom nodes for instruction-driven editing that maintains subject identity.
